contamination_risks: All development inputs are previously exposed and cannot satisfy confirmation maturity.
No predecessor strategy metric or trial ranking is reused.
The 310-session confirmation target block is globally untouched at freeze.
The first five post-development full sessions are an immutable embargo.
Incomplete sessions are explicit missed zero-return dates with no interpolation.
family_contract.entry_rule: Require the frozen positive opening return and completed above-VWAP confirmation, then enter only at the exact next observable minute open.
family_contract.exit_rule: Exit stop-first on same-bar ambiguity, at the frozen R target, or at the regular-session final close.
family_contract.expected_holding_behavior: Long only and flat no later than five trading sessions after entry.
falsifiers: opening momentum fails to persist after VWAP confirmation
family_contract.material_difference_rationale: The configured Alpaca SIP minute history begins in 2016. This exact version uses 1,000 provider-covered sessions for selection while explicitly treating them as contaminated training, then tests only a frozen later 310-session block for confirmation.
family_contract.mechanism: After a positive 30- or 60-minute index-ETF opening impulse, require one or two additional completed closes above cumulative session VWAP, enter on the next minute, and exit at the frozen ATR stop, R target, or session close.
family_contract.primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological account log growth after costs.
production_compatibility_risks: Live quotes, spread, depth, halt, tradability, timing, protection, and reconciliation remain required.
family_contract.ranking_rule: Earliest confirmation first, then strongest completed opening return, then canonical symbol.
family_contract.selection_rule: At most one new family entry per day under the portfolio-wide risk, notional, and capital-contention caps.
family_contract.stop_rule: Freeze a long stop one or one-and-a-half completed intraday ATR below entry.

universe_requirements.selection_basis: Four fixed highly liquid broad U.S. index ETFs; an incomplete symbol-session makes the entire entry date a missed zero-return day.
